messages:
marco: FYI a customer hit a confusing flow during quickstart. They accepted the invite, added payment, saw the UI say "Ready", but their first call hangs then returns 402. They think setup is finished. :confused:

    tina: Can you paste the exact request they made and which sample?

    marco: Using the Python sample app from our repo. They copied the token from the app screen and ran: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_YYY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood/mini","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -> HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required {"error":"billing_required","message":"Workspace billing not enabled"}

    raj: 402 indicates billing not active yet. We often have a short lag while the billing provider webhook finishes. Does the sample SDK retry on these errors? If it retries aggressively users may think requests fail or be billed multiple times.

    marco: The sample uses SDK v0.9.0 pinned in the template. The app log shows: "INFO Starting request" then "ERROR 402 billing_required" then three SDK retries quickly and finally a 200 after ~35s when webhook finished. The user was worried about charges and the UI showing Ready prematurely.

    infra-bot: Note: billing attach webhook average latency ~12s, p95 ~40s in eu-west-1 (last 24h).

    tina: Two quick fixes: (1) change sample app to poll workspace.status and show a clear "Payment processing \u2014 please wait" state until backend confirms provisioning, (2) change SDK default retry policy to not retry on 4xx billing errors.

    raj: Agreed. Current SDK retries on any HTTP error except 4xx/5xx classification is wrong in pinned older version. We'll treat non-retriable codes: 400-499 except 429. Also add a visible note in quickstart docs about potential ~30s delay after adding a card.

    marco: I'll contact the user, reassure them they're not charged for failed attempts and explain the timing window. Also attach the runbook link: https://intranet.redwood.ai/runbooks/onboarding-waiting-for-billing

    tina: I'll open a PR to update the sample UI text and add a small loading check for workspace.provisioned == true before flipping Ready. Target staging deploy today.

    raj: I'll prepare SDK patch (v0.9.1-hotfix) and add unit tests asserting no retry on 402. Will include an override option for edge cases.

    support-bot: Created ticket SUP-1098 for the customer outreach and marked their workspace as "investigated".

    marco: Thanks. One follow-up for docs team: can we add a short blurb in Quickstart "Billing can take up to 1 minute to process; if you see 402, wait ~30s and retry". That should lower confusion.

    tina: Good call. Small UX win and SDK policy fix should avoid most of these.

    raj: Adding this to the onboarding backlog and tagging PMs. Closing here once SDK patch merged and sample deployed.

    marco: Closing for now, will reopen if user reports more trouble. :thumbsup:
